lines.en: My wings are bright white as paper.

lines.zh: 白翅在花海上，很难看清。
lines.en: White wings vanish over the flower field.

lines.zh: 花海上飞一圈，露水都干了。
lines.en: One lap of the flower field dries the dew.
One flick of my white wings and I move on.
Something stirs inside the flower.
Who stirred up the pollen?

lines.zh: 白翅落在花海，几乎看不见。
lines.en: White wings on a flower field, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 气流往哪，我的翅就往哪。
lines.en: Where the air current goes, my wings go.
Past this flower sea, I rest.
The flower stems are thick all along here.

lines.zh: 慢点，别惊动白桦下的孢子。
lines.en: Slow down; do not stir the birch spores.
The birch grove's current is truly annoying.
My wings ache; one more stretch.
Light sways through the leaf gaps, so bright.

lines.zh: 桦树的白皮上，我的白翅看不见。
lines.en: On birch bark my white wings vanish.

lines.zh: 这段花径我闭眼也能飞。
lines.en: I could fly this flower path blind.

lines.zh: 桦木林的白，跟我翅膀一个色。
lines.en: Birch white matches my wings.
This white bloom looks like snow.
The wind pushes; I refuse to go.
I see myself in the dew.
Who sighs behind the flowers?
My wings are heavy; I pause.
I am waiting for a warm gust.
So quiet, only the sound of wings.
A dewdrop bursts; another forms.

lines.zh: 花海这么大，我只认这一朵。
lines.en: The flower forest is vast; I know only this bloom.
The white birch flowers are mine.
Dew on white wings, a little heavier.

lines.zh: 这一朵白花，我数到第五瓣。
lines.en: This white bloom — I count five petals.
Resting like this is not bad.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，翅膀会碰网。
lines.en: You stand too close; wings meet net.
You lower your head and the flower shadows dim.
You land so clumsily.
You stay silent, and so do I.
In the water you're clumsier than a stone.
You stand in the flowers like a birch.

lines.zh: 你举着网，我停在桦树皮上。
lines.en: You raise a net; I rest on birch bark.

lines.zh: 你走近，花粉都飘起来了。
lines.en: You come close, and the pollen lifts.
My white wings look like torn paper.
Two big eyes — you are no flower.
A pang at my wing base sends me spinning.

lines.zh: 桦木林的风，把我吹偏了。
lines.en: The birch wind pushed me off course.

lines.zh: 我的翅沾了水，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wings are wet; I can't fly.
I must land on a leaf to catch my breath.
I'm this small. Worth a hook?
A little of my wing scales came off.
You hurt a vein in my wing.
Back off; I can still fly.
One corner of my wing is crumpled.

lines.zh: 白翅上的鳞粉，撒了一地。
lines.en: Scale dust from my white wings litters the ground.
Who planted flowers this dense?
The scent circles my antennae.

lines.zh: 我翅上的白线，细得像丝。
lines.en: The white lines on my wings are fine as thread.
Is that really a poppy?

lines.zh: 你手腕一转，我便贴近一分。
lines.en: You turn your wrist, and I close in a little.

lines.zh: 桦木的白皮，替我做了伪装。
lines.en: Birch bark gives me my disguise.
White wings — just one sniff.
Let me look at that flower once more.
Save me a sip of nectar.
This nectar is sweeter than dew.

lines.zh: 翅上的露水被你碰落了。
lines.en: You knocked the dew off my wings.
You nearly fanned off my white scales.

lines.zh: 翅面的鳞，被你蹭掉一片。
lines.en: A patch of wing scales rubbed off on you.
White wings open like a falling leaf.
Excuse me, my wings cannot open here.

lines.zh: 别把我撞进那片白花丛。
lines.en: Do not knock me into that white flower bank.
You scattered pollen all through the air.
Leave me a gap between the birches.

lines.zh: 撞得我在花间打了个旋。
lines.en: The bump sent me spinning among the flowers.

lines.zh: 你从背后过来，翅都皱了。
lines.en: You came from behind and crumpled my wing.

lines.zh: 我翅尖这点白，像桦树皮。
lines.en: The white at my wingtips looks like birch bark.

lines.zh: 你的翅白得像晚霞的边。
lines.en: Your wings are white as the edge of dusk.

lines.zh: 风会替我们记着这一天。
lines.en: The wind will remember this day for us.

lines.zh: 你落在花上，我翅都轻了。
lines.en: You land on a bloom, and my wings feel light.

lines.zh: 我带来一朵刚开的雏菊。
lines.en: I brought a freshly opened daisy.

lines.zh: 我沿着白桦林找你的翅。
lines.en: I followed the birch grove for your wings.

lines.zh: 两只白翅，一上一下地飞。
lines.en: Two white wings, flying one above the other.
We fly until the sun leans west.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶画了个白圈。
lines.en: I trace a white circle above you.
Birch white suits me.
It weighs on my wing and I fly askew.
A petal drifts down.

lines.zh: 白色的翅，在花海里最不起眼。
lines.en: White wings vanish in a flower sea.
This glint, I tuck under my wing.
This clump of pollen goes onto my hind leg.
White wings. Need a twig to rest on.
Dust on white wings. I must groom.

lines.zh: 白翅膀在桦树皮上一闪。
lines.en: White wings flash on birch bark.
Why is this inside a flower?
I will tuck it into a bark crevice.

lines.zh: 桦木林里我一闪就没了。
lines.en: In the birch wood I vanish in a blink.
This flower opened; I have waited.
I fix on the tallest bloom.
The white blooms hide my shape.
That bug stopped moving.
White wings on a birch trunk.
That sweetness is right there.
That flower moves; I go first.

lines.zh: 白翅膀一闪，你就找不着了。
lines.en: One flash of white wings and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 白翅一合，就看不见我了。
lines.en: Close the white wings and I vanish.
Circling you beats gathering nectar.
I have crossed this flower sea a hundred times.
Around a stem, and another stem.
The flower sea is only so big — accept it.
Wherever you stand, I see you.
Hide under a leaf; it will not help.

lines.zh: 你碰落的花瓣出卖了你。
lines.en: The petal you knocked loose gives you away.
My wing shadow is almost on you.

lines.zh: 白翅一闪，你就该看见我了。
lines.en: One white flick and you should have seen me.
Listen: the wind counts for me.
Reach again and I climb high.
I bump your nose tip — just once.

lines.zh: 白桦叶背，是我的产卵处。
lines.en: The birch leaf underside is where I lay eggs.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，但翅鳞会刺痒。
lines.en: I have no teeth, but my scales itch.
In a flower field, white is hardest to spot.
I rake your knuckle with my wing edge.
I can flap once more.

lines.zh: 我翅下的细纹，是白桦的花。
lines.en: The fine lines under my wings are birch flowers.
I fan pollen in your face — go away.
The white on my wing is a warning.

lines.zh: 桦木林的花，一朵接一朵开。
lines.en: The birch wood flowers open one after another.

lines.zh: 我刚落到这片花海的水边。
lines.en: I just landed by this flower field's water.
I broke out of the chrysalis, wings still damp.
The dawn dew is cool; my wings wake.
These birches — I know them.
This gust is holding me up.
Do not pinch me; my wings are not stiff yet.
Spread wings first — they are still soft.

lines.zh: 花海这么静，翅都不敢动。
lines.en: The flower sea is so still my wings hold.
I poke my antennae from the flower's heart.
Hot! The edge of my wing is curling!
I hit a trunk, and my wing face smarts.

lines.zh: 我掉进水里，翅膀粘住了。
lines.en: I fell in and my wings are stuck together.
The blast wave flips my wings over.
An arrow came through the water.
Who is casting on my wing scales?

lines.zh: 蜜源太远，我翅都扇不动。
lines.en: The nectar is too far; my wings will not beat.
A waterside butterfly fears thunder most.

lines.zh: 虚空里连我的白翅也看不见了。
lines.en: In the void even my white wings vanish.
